title: Logix Smart Nasopharyngeal Covid-19 Plating (Station A)
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare plate and reservoirs
steps.instruction: Place a NEST 96‑deepwell plate on the deck, load up to four Opentrons tuberacks with the nasopharyngeal samples, and fill a NEST 12‑channel reservoir with lysis/binding buffer, samples, and elution buffer as shown in the transfer diagram. Leave deepwells A1 and B1 empty for later addition of controls.

steps.title: Input protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required protocol parameters in the OT App interface before running the script.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol .py file from the provided link and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the appropriate .json labware definition files for any custom plates or reservoirs.

steps.title: Upload protocol file to OT App
steps.instruction: Navigate to the Protocol tab in the OT App and upload the downloaded .py protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck per deck map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck layout exactly as shown in the provided deck map, placing the deepwell plate, tuberacks, reservoir, and tip rack in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App calibration routine to calibrate the positions of the deepwell plate, reservoir, tip rack, and the pipette. Refer to the Opentrons support articles for detailed calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the ‘Run’ button in the OT App to start the automated plating sequence.
